source: CHANGELOG.md of openduo/duoduo, read per release against maps/history_daemon.json

CHANNEL_CONFIG_KEY_TYPES.changelog: enable and tune per conversation with `duoduo session config <session> set auto_compact_idle_minutes=50 auto_compact_min_context_tokens=100000`.
CHANNEL_CONFIG_KEY_TYPES.why: Declares auto_compact_idle_minutes and auto_compact_min_context_tokens as nonneg_number config keys.

SpineRpcParamsError.changelog: `spine.record` appends an `external.record` event for writers outside duoduo, with optional per-source deduplication.
SpineRpcParamsError.why: Error class thrown by recordExternalSpineEvent and runSpineCatRpc for invalid spine.record / spine.cat params.

accumulateDrainRecordIntoSummary.why: Adds one drain record to the running summary per provider ("anthropic", "codex", "grok", "pi").

acquireSessionDrainLock.changelog: **runner**: Keep session lock heartbeat and release ownership inside the active drain so actors that never acquired the lock cannot renew or delete it.
acquireSessionDrainLock.why: Acquire path of the session drain lock changed in this release and reads the lock file through readDrainLockFile.

advanceOptimisticDeliveryCursor.changelog: **replay**: Harden session-local cursor fallback and recovery when replay indexes are incomplete or stale.
advanceOptimisticDeliveryCursor.why: Writes the session-local optimistic delivery cursor (optimistic_last_outbox_id, optimistic_replay_offset) and records cursor_store_ms; part of the session-local cursor handling.

aggregateSessionDrainSummary.why: Accumulates drain records into a usage summary while iterating (for await), instead of collecting all records first.

appendBeforeExecuteGateway.changelog: Identical text sent twice was silently suppressed as a duplicate. Ingress de-duplication now keys only on an explicit source id, so resending a message always gets an answer.
appendBeforeExecuteGateway.why: Gateway ingest now calls computeDedupKey, which keys only on dedup.source_id.

appendConfigChangedEvent.changelog: enable and tune per conversation with `duoduo session config <session> set auto_compact_idle_minutes=50 auto_compact_min_context_tokens=100000`.
appendConfigChangedEvent.why: Appends a config.changed event with source session.config when the config is set.

appendEventIdIndexEntry.changelog: The by-id index is now a bounded recency cache keyed on event date and compacted at boot (`ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS`, 7 days by default).
appendEventIdIndexEntry.why: Index writer changed in the release that made the by-id index a date-keyed recency cache.

appendEventToPartition.changelog: Log lines containing U+2028 were shredded on read, because the line reader treated it as a line break and JSON does not.
appendEventToPartition.why: Now serialises the WAL line through stringifyJsonlRecord, which escapes U+2028.

appendGapHandedSpan.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
appendGapHandedSpan.why: Appends a handed span to the gap-handed-days record in memory/.

appendSessionMailboxNote.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
appendSessionMailboxNote.why: Appends a note to mailbox/notes.jsonl instead of rewriting the mailbox file (append-only mailbox).

applyHostModelEnvVars.changelog: fix(daemon): forward ANTHROPIC_* env and apply onboard state on upgrade
applyHostModelEnvVars.why: Sets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL vars from the onboard model config.

applyJobSdkConfigOverride.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
applyJobSdkConfigOverride.why: Overlays a job's claudeModelProfiles/claudeModelAliases onto the base config with source "instance".

applySessionConfigVerb.changelog: enable and tune per conversation with `duoduo session config <session> set auto_compact_idle_minutes=50 auto_compact_min_context_tokens=100000`.
applySessionConfigVerb.why: Implements the get/set/unset verbs of session config against a session resolved by key or alias.

archiveLegacyRegistrySessionsDir.changelog: `var/registry/sessions/` is no longer read on the hot path and is archived to `var/registry.legacy.<ts>/` on first post-upgrade start
archiveLegacyRegistrySessionsDir.why: Body logs the literal "Phase 3 of session-state-refactor: session metadata now lives in var/sessions/" under [init] and counts backfilled/skipped rows, the one-shot legacy registry sweep (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

archiveSessionAndArtifacts.changelog: `session.archive` RPC + `duoduo session archive <session_key>` CLI retired the old ad-hoc deletion paths. Archive moves the session dir to `var/sessions-archive/`; recovery is `mv` back.
archiveSessionAndArtifacts.why: Moves the session dir plus channels-archive/ingress-archive/outbox-archive artifacts under the per-session mutex via moveSessionDirToArchive, returning not_found/pending_work (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

archiveSessionAndArtifacts.changelog: Archiving now refuses unless the session is provably empty of pending work (checking every shape of in-flight work), ignores channel placeholder actors, and treats the archive marker as a real "about to disappear" signal.
archiveSessionAndArtifacts.why: Now calls the new probeSessionPendingWork before archiving.

archiveSessionIfQuiescent.changelog: `session.archive` RPC + `duoduo session archive <session_key>` CLI retired the old ad-hoc deletion paths. Archive moves the session dir to `var/sessions-archive/`; recovery is `mv` back.
archiveSessionIfQuiescent.why: RPC-level handler whose messages include "Archived — to recover, `mv` the archived directory back" and refuse live actors/queued work (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

archiveSessionIfQuiescent.changelog: Archiving now refuses unless the session is provably empty of pending work (checking every shape of in-flight work), ignores channel placeholder actors, and treats the archive marker as a real "about to disappear" signal.
archiveSessionIfQuiescent.why: Now calls the new probeSessionPendingWork before archiving.

assertScheduleDurationRepresentable.changelog: `@in` and `@every` now accept composite durations such as `2h30m` and `1d6h4m`. Invalid cron strings, malformed durations, and delays outside the representable time range are rejected when the job is created.
assertScheduleDurationRepresentable.why: Throws "Duration in ... is too large to schedule — it exceeds the representable time range", the entry's representable-range rejection.

assertSessionNotArchiving.changelog: Closes the last class of "writer survives past archive's liveness check and writes into a just-renamed path" races.
assertSessionNotArchiving.why: Throws when a writer reaches a session that is being archived; called by every state writer (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

attachStreamLineReader.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
attachStreamLineReader.why: Line reader on the pi worker stdout, called only by createPiWorkerAdapter.

backfillOutboxByIdIndexFromReplay.changelog: **replay**: Harden session-local cursor fallback and recovery when replay indexes are incomplete or stale.
backfillOutboxByIdIndexFromReplay.why: Rebuilds missing by_id index entries (replay_offset, replay_byte_length) by scanning the session's replay file, i.e. recovery when the replay index is incomplete.

bindSessionSourceChannel.changelog: `channel.ingress` and `channel.command` validate `channel_id` before they bind the session. A malformed id used to rebind an existing session to it and was refused only afterwards.
bindSessionSourceChannel.why: Calls assertValidChannelId(channel_id) before patchSessionRuntimeState writes source_channel_id, i.e. validates before binding.

buildBaseInstructions.changelog: feat(codex): Codex app-server adapter (Phase 1) for running job sessions on GPT-5.4
buildBaseInstructions.why: Builds the <aladuo:system-context> base instructions sent to the Codex app-server.

buildClaudeCostBaseline.changelog: A resumed turn now reports its own figures. A session that existed before the upgrade has no saved baseline yet, so its first resume shows no cost and no model.
buildClaudeCostBaseline.why: Builds the saved baseline {sdk_session_id, total_cost_usd, model_usage} that a resumed Claude turn subtracts.

buildClaudeSettingsEnvOverrides.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
buildClaudeSettingsEnvOverrides.why: Builds the env override set only for a "profiled-external" requirement, i.e. a gateway-served model with a declared profile.

buildCodexDirectOnlyToolConfig.changelog: duoduo's tools are mounted under their own namespace and pinned to the top level, so they no longer get demoted out of the model's directly-visible tool list
buildCodexDirectOnlyToolConfig.why: Returns a config keyed by the direct-only option listing [ALADUO_TOOL_NAMESPACE], i.e. pins duoduo's namespace to the top level.

buildCodexDynamicTools.changelog: Dynamic tools bridge: aladuo MCP tools available to Codex sessions
buildCodexDynamicTools.why: Builds Codex dynamic tools that call runNotifyTool, runManageJobTool, runSkipTool and the other aladuo tool handlers.

buildCodexStringInputSchema.changelog: Dynamic tools bridge: aladuo MCP tools available to Codex sessions
buildCodexStringInputSchema.why: Builds the JSON input schema for the bridged tools; only buildCodexDynamicTools uses it.

buildCodexTurnInput.changelog: **Codex sessions accept inbound images** as first-class turn input rather than as a path the model has to open for itself.
buildCodexTurnInput.why: Maps attachments whose mime starts with "image/" to a {type: "localImage"} turn-input item next to the "text" item.

buildDeveloperInstructions.changelog: feat(codex): Codex app-server adapter (Phase 1) for running job sessions on GPT-5.4
buildDeveloperInstructions.why: Builds the <aladuo:runtime-directives> developer instructions sent to the Codex app-server.

buildEffectiveRuntimeFields.changelog: In a channel kind or instance descriptor it refuses the turns of the sessions that layer selects; a valid instance value still overrides an unknown kind value.
buildEffectiveRuntimeFields.why: Turns resolveLayeredChannelRuntime's result into either a runtime or a runtimeRefusal field for the effective channel config.

buildJobRuntimeSchemaField.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
buildJobRuntimeSchemaField.why: Builds the job runtime enum from listSelectableJobRuntimes, which in this release always appends "pi".

buildNotifyInputSchema.changelog: adds `correlation_id` / `reply_to` fields to the Notify MCP tool
buildNotifyInputSchema.why: Schema now contains correlation_id and reply_to

buildOrphanIslandsSignal.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints
buildOrphanIslandsSignal.why: Builds the orphan-islands.md.pending signal addressed to the intuition-weaver partition, i.e. a signal routed to a subconscious partition.

buildOrphanNewbornSignals.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints
buildOrphanNewbornSignals.why: Builds orphan-newborn-*.md.pending signals and routes them to a partition via routeContractDecision.

buildPiSystemPromptSpec.changelog: the same kind/instance/job/partition prompt fields including append-or-replace
buildPiSystemPromptSpec.why: Builds pi's system prompt spec from mode "append" or "override", the append-or-replace prompt field the entry names.

buildProfiledExternalRequirement.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
buildProfiledExternalRequirement.why: Builds the "profiled-external" requirement object for a model that has a declared profile.

buildScanGapSignal.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
buildScanGapSignal.why: Builds a signal for the "gradient-distiller" partition naming a bounded event interval to process.

buildSdkConfigReport.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
buildSdkConfigReport.why: Reports the auth source (default "claude_code_local") and ALADUO_PERMISSION_MODE in system.config's SDK section.

buildSessionExecutionPayload.changelog: **runner**: Expose `tool_input_delta` in `session.execution` notifications for progressive tool input rendering.
buildSessionExecutionPayload.why: Builds the session.execution notification payload, which gained the tool input delta in this release.

buildSessionIndexEntry.changelog: `SessionIndex` is now the in-memory derived view of `var/sessions/<hash>/state.json`
buildSessionIndexEntry.why: Turns one session's state/meta into an index entry (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

buildSessionIndexFromDisk.changelog: `SessionIndex` is now the in-memory derived view of `var/sessions/<hash>/state.json` (completes Phase 3 of session-state-refactor; `var/registry/sessions/` is no longer read on the hot path
buildSessionIndexFromDisk.why: Builds the index from readAllSessionStateFiles + readSessionMetaFile, i.e. derived from state.json rather than the registry (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

buildSystemConfigReport.changelog: **daemon**: `system.config` RPC — inspect effective runtime configuration (network, sessions, cadence, SDK, paths) with source tracking (`env` / `default` / `unset`).
buildSystemConfigReport.why: Builds the report of ALADUO_* settings grouped as network, sessions, cadence, SDK and paths, the system.config response.
Lists ALADUO_TELEMETRY_ENABLED among the reported env entries.

buildTransientUserBlocks.changelog: **runner**: Add configurable time-gap session context and upgrade runtime prompt assembly to structured content blocks.
buildTransientUserBlocks.why: Per-turn transient blocks gained the time-gap context and moved to structured content blocks in this release.

buildTransientUserBlocks.changelog: A one-line notice on the session's next reply reports what was compacted and its measured stats, so retuning is based on real numbers rather than guesswork. See the `smart-compaction` skill
buildTransientUserBlocks.why: Gains the compactNotice branch that adds a smart-compact-notice block via renderSmartCompactNoticeBlock.

buildTransientUserBlocks.changelog: `-r "<what changed>"` reaches every session that wakes after the restart
buildTransientUserBlocks.why: Passes getPendingRestartReason() to renderDaemonRestartHint for the daemon-restart-hint block.

canonicalizeGatewayCommand.changelog: `/compact` and `/undo` work everywhere. Type them in any channel (Feishu DM, stdio, ACP editor).
Type `/model` to list available models ... Kick off a self-pacing loop with `/loop <task>`.
canonicalizeGatewayCommand.why: Gains the "/model" case in 0.5.6; the literal does not exist in 0.5.5.

checkChannelRuntimeRebindConflict.changelog: **Changing a session's runtime needs `/clear` first.** A session is now bound to the runtime that created its history.
checkChannelRuntimeRebindConflict.why: Refuses "runtime not changed to '…'" when sessions "hold history that only their current runtime can resume" and says "Send /clear in each of those sessions first".

checkCodexAvailability.changelog: Preflight check for codex CLI availability
checkCodexAvailability.why: Runs codex --version and codex login status and reports 'Codex CLI ... is not installed or not in PATH'.

checkGrokAvailability.changelog: Availability is checked against the Grok CLI you already have installed, and it fails closed: asking for Grok when Grok is not usable gives you a clear error, never a silent fall back to Claude.
checkGrokAvailability.why: Runs `grok --version` and returns "Grok CLI ('…') is not installed or not in PATH. Install it and run 'grok login'." on failure.

checkGrokAvailability.changelog: A failed Grok availability probe reported a login problem regardless of the real cause.
checkGrokAvailability.why: Body changed in this release; the fix concerns its failure reason, but the diff was not inspected.

checkReservedRecordSource.changelog: `spine.record` appends an `external.record` event for writers outside duoduo, with optional per-source deduplication.
checkReservedRecordSource.why: Refuses ("reserved_source") a spine.record source that is one of duoduo's internal sources or begins its session keys; the entry's writers outside duoduo record under their own name.

claimDaemonRestartReason.changelog: `duoduo daemon restart` takes a reason, and can wake what it interrupted. `-r "<what changed>"` reaches every session that wakes after the restart; `--wake <session-or-alias>` (repeatable) notifies a specific session
claimDaemonRestartReason.why: Reads and deletes daemon-restart-reason.json and returns its reason and wake_targets; the file is absent from 0.6.1.

classifyConsumerStaleness.changelog: whose last consumer take is older than `ALADUO_NOTIFY_UNCONSUMED_HOURS`
classifyConsumerStaleness.why: Compares last_cursor_advance_at age with hours * factor and returns unconsumed=false when the setting is <= 0 (off).

classifyDrainBatchClass.changelog: A message you send while the agent is mid-turn on something it started by itself now gets its own turn. It used to be folded into that turn
classifyDrainBatchClass.why: Assigns each drain item a merge class ("worker-notify", channel message, other) so a user channel.message is not merged into a self-started batch.

classifyGatewayCommandIntent.changelog: Type `/model` to list available models, `/model <id>` to switch the running session
classifyGatewayCommandIntent.why: Gains the mapping of /model to the "config" intent in 0.5.6.

classifyJobScheduleType.changelog: fix(job): wire system-level notify delivery and fix child job routing (9e7b13b)
classifyJobScheduleType.why: Returns "one-shot"/"periodic", the second argument the 0.4.0 fallback-notification text branches on.

classifyModelContextRequirement.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
classifyModelContextRequirement.why: Classifies a model as "native-claude", "explicit-1m" or "profiled-external", deciding whether a declared window applies.

claudeUnavailableReason.changelog: Hosts can expose whichever runtimes are actually installed and authenticated.
claudeUnavailableReason.why: Returns the cached probe failure reason

clearHostModelEnvConfig.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
clearHostModelEnvConfig.why: Removes the onboarding model/auth lines from the host .env file.

clearHostModelEnvVars.changelog: fix(daemon): forward ANTHROPIC_* env and apply onboard state on upgrade
clearHostModelEnvVars.why: Deletes the HOST_MODEL_ENV_KEYS before applyHostModelEnvVars re-applies the onboard state.

clearModelOverrideOnRuntimeFlip.changelog: `/model <id>` to switch the running session, `/model reset` to restore the daemon default. On Claude sessions the change takes effect on the next turn; on Codex sessions it is applied at the next thread fork.
clearModelOverrideOnRuntimeFlip.why: Clears the session model override (model, model_runtime, pending_model_fork) when the runtime changes; part of /model session state handling.

clearSessionArchiving.changelog: re-checks the archiving marker after the lock is taken.
clearSessionArchiving.why: Clears the archiving marker after an archive attempt (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

clearSessionRuntimeStateField.changelog: `updateSessionRuntimeState`, and `enqueueMailboxItem` now take the same lock that `archiveSessionDir` takes.
clearSessionRuntimeStateField.why: state.json field remover that runs inside runWithSessionMutex and calls assertSessionNotArchiving (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

codexNotificationFilterDecision.changelog: A recurring Codex job no longer mishandles a turn-terminal notification, which previously could let a job thread grow until it repeatedly hit compaction.
codexNotificationFilterDecision.why: Decides drop-wrong-thread / drop-stale-turn for Codex notifications with an exception for turn/completed and error

collectBoardIncludePaths.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself
collectBoardIncludePaths.why: Scans markdown tokens (skipping code/codespan, html comments) for include tokens and resolves them relative to the file

collectBoardLintReport.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints
collectBoardLintReport.why: Measures every board-reachable target (buildBoardLintTarget) and feeds runBoardLint.

collectGrokToolCallNames.changelog: duoduo's own tools reachable from it
collectGrokToolCallNames.why: Reads tool names from Grok's "x.ai/tool" metadata on a tool call so duoduo's own tools can be recognised.

collectInstructionsInputs.changelog: The per-session sticky-mission guard now fingerprints identity + kind prompt + instance prompt + memory board + mission, not just the mission.
collectInstructionsInputs.why: Gathers exactly those inputs: resolveMetaPromptText (identity), resolveEffectiveChannelConfig (kind/instance prompts), the memory board, and the job mission

collectInstructionsInputs.changelog: injects the rendered import graph into both Claude and Codex sessions through one path.
collectInstructionsInputs.why: Now calls transcludeBroadcastBoard for the memory-board input

collectJobCompletionReceipts.changelog: A finished job's completion receipt now arrives as context on the owner's next turn instead of waking a turn of its own.
collectJobCompletionReceipts.why: Collects job-completion events (extractJobCompletionJobId) from the drain items and renders them as prompt context for the turn.

computeBoundedEditDistance.changelog: Notify "target not found" error now matches candidates scope-aware (session_key prefix + channel kind), yielding actionable suggestions.
computeBoundedEditDistance.why: Edit-distance helper only called by matchNearMissSessionKey (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

computeCodexTurnUsage.changelog: Every finalized turn now appends a one-line footer ... The footer now includes an absolute context-token count (`ctx Nk`)
computeCodexTurnUsage.why: Computes per-turn Codex token deltas against a baseline and sets context_used_tokens, the source of the ctx segment.

computeContextProfileSignature.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
computeContextProfileSignature.why: sha256 hex signature of a "profiled-external" profile, so a profile change is detected per session.

computeDedupKey.changelog: Identical text sent twice was silently suppressed as a duplicate. Ingress de-duplication now keys only on an explicit source id, so resending a message always gets an answer.
computeDedupKey.why: Returns a key only when dedup.source_id is present (`${source.kind}:${source_id}`), else null: de-duplication keyed only on an explicit source id.

computeInstructionsFingerprint.changelog: the legacy `mission_fingerprint` field is cleared, and the new `instructions_fingerprint` is stamped.
computeInstructionsFingerprint.why: sha256 hex digest over the collected instruction inputs

computeMissionFingerprint.changelog: the legacy `mission_fingerprint` field is cleared, and the new `instructions_fingerprint` is stamped.
computeMissionFingerprint.why: Legacy mission-only fingerprint re-expressed as computeInstructionsFingerprint({mission})

computeOrphanTopicNodes.changelog: `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET=1` additionally lets it remove long-stale, board-unreachable orphan nodes (git-recoverable).
computeOrphanTopicNodes.why: Computes topic nodes unreachable from the board (walkReachableMemory) with their in-degree and age, the "board-unreachable orphan" set.

computePartitionBackoffUntil.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
computePartitionBackoffUntil.why: Computes a per-partition backoff deadline from the run outcome ("success", "timeout", "invalid_output"), so a failing partition no longer stalls the round-robin.

createAgentSdkAdapter.changelog: **Claude Code's own auto memory is off** in every Claude session duoduo starts, because it would keep a second memory store beside duoduo's.
createAgentSdkAdapter.why: The Claude session env now sets CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY = "1" (and ALADUO_CALLER_SESSION).

createCodexAppServerAdapter.changelog: feat(codex): Codex app-server adapter (Phase 1) for running job sessions on GPT-5.4
createCodexAppServerAdapter.why: The Codex app-server adapter itself: thread/*, item/* notifications, [codex-adapter] and [codex-transport] logs, AbortError on abort.

createCodexAppServerAdapter.changelog: The new behavior calls `thread/fork` from the parent rollout when one is available … Falls back to `thread/start` if the parent rollout has been GC'd.
createCodexAppServerAdapter.why: Body contains both thread/fork and thread/start

createDaemon.changelog: That interface now lives on a socket file that carries owner-only permissions, so the operating system enforces what nothing was enforcing before.
createDaemon.why: "daemon.sock" appears in the bundle first in v0.7.0 (0 hits in v0.6.2), and createDaemon is the current holder of it.

createEmptySessionIndex.changelog: `SessionIndex` is now the in-memory derived view of `var/sessions/<hash>/state.json`
createEmptySessionIndex.why: Empty variant of createMapBackedSessionIndex (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

createGrokAcpAdapter.changelog: It sits behind the same seam as Claude and Codex rather than beside it: one long-lived agent process per session, duoduo's own tools reachable from it, mid-turn steering, and the same kind/instance/job/partition prompt fields
createGrokAcpAdapter.why: The Grok ACP adapter: spawns one grok process ("--always-approve", "--no-leader") and drives "session/new", "session/load", "session/prompt", "session/cancel", "session/set_model".

createIdleCompactSweeper.changelog: A channel session that has sat idle past a configurable threshold and grown past a token floor now silently runs `/compact` on its next turn
createIdleCompactSweeper.why: Reads auto_compact_idle_minutes / auto_compact_min_context_tokens per session and ingests "/compact" into idle channel sessions ([idle-compact]).

createJobSessionFinalizer.changelog: Job results went nowhere when the job had no explicit audience; the owner is now the default, and a job can no longer disappear without a trace.
createJobSessionFinalizer.why: Logs "job outcome delivered to owner" / "undeliverable: no owner_session", delivering job results to owner_session by default (body likely restructured from older job finalisation).

createMapBackedSessionIndex.changelog: `SessionIndex` is now the in-memory derived view of `var/sessions/<hash>/state.json`
createMapBackedSessionIndex.why: The Map-backed in-memory index object (classifies keys, filters user-visible) (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

createMetaSession.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
createMetaSession.why: Partition scheduler body changed in this release and now calls computePartitionBackoffUntil.

createModelCommandResolvers.why: Returns the void-runtime refusal text (initVoidRuntimeModule's constant) for model commands on a void session.

createPiWorkerAdapter.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
createPiWorkerAdapter.why: The pi runtime adapter: spawns the pi worker process, exchanges exec/abort/compact frames and maps aborts to the shared AgentSdk turn errors.

createVoidAwareAttachmentCallbacks.changelog: A new runtime value, `void`, for channel plugins whose sessions never run a model. A message to a void session is written to the spine and the outbox and wakes nothing.
createVoidAwareAttachmentCallbacks.why: onAttach skips attaching the session when isVoidRuntimeSession is true, so a void session's message wakes nothing.

daemonRestartReasonPath.changelog: `duoduo daemon restart` takes a reason, and can wake what it interrupted. `-r "<what changed>"` reaches every session that wakes after the restart; `--wake <session-or-alias>` (repeatable) notifies a specific session
daemonRestartReasonPath.why: Returns the path of daemon-restart-reason.json, the file that carries the restart reason.

deleteMailboxPendingItemsByEventIds.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
deleteMailboxPendingItemsByEventIds.why: Removes consumed mailbox/pending/*.item.json files by event id, the delete half of the per-item mailbox.

deliverExternalSessionNotify.changelog: `duoduo session notify <target> -m "<msg>"` — wake another session by key or alias with a source-tagged notification (for cross-session orchestration). Only foreground/job sessions are valid targets; the kernel/subconscious plane is isolated and refused.
deliverExternalSessionNotify.why: Handles session.notify with source "external:session.notify", refuses forbidden_kind via resolveIsolatedPlaneKind

deliverScanGapSignal.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
deliverScanGapSignal.why: Posts the scan-gap signal to the "gradient-distiller" inbox and records the handed span.

describeChannelInstance.changelog: descriptors carry `runtime` (`claude`|`codex`) and spawn provenance; new `channel.describe` / `channel.spawn` RPCs expose the instance lifecycle to channel plugins.
describeChannelInstance.why: Handler behind channel.describe: reads the channel descriptor and resolves its runtime (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

describeChannelInstance.changelog: Setup cards only show runtime choices the daemon can actually run.
describeChannelInstance.why: channel.describe handler now reports runtime availability ("available") to the channel

describeContextProfileSource.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
describeContextProfileSource.why: Renders the source of the context profile ("explicit-1m", "native-claude", "profiled-external", "unprofiled") for status output.

describeSpineCatProblem.why: Contains "\"redact\" must be \"external\" or left out", the validator of the new spine.cat redact parameter.

describeSpineRecordProblem.changelog: `spine.record` appends an `external.record` event for writers outside duoduo, with optional per-source deduplication.
describeSpineRecordProblem.why: Protocol validator for spine.record params (source, payload, dedup_key, conversation); renderParamsProblem("spine.record") reports it.

detectOrphanMemory.changelog: `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET=1` additionally lets it remove long-stale, board-unreachable orphan nodes (git-recoverable).
detectOrphanMemory.why: Classifies orphan topic nodes into ISLAND / NEWBORN / STALE; STALE is the class forgetMemoryEntry removes.

disableSystemPromptSnapshot.changelog: duoduo now explicitly opts out of the agent SDK's new system-prompt recording default.
disableSystemPromptSnapshot.why: Wraps the system prompt as {type: "custom", …, snapshot: false}; "snapshot: !1" first appears in the bundle in v0.8.1.

drainSessionMailbox.changelog: surfaces a per-session "runtime unavailable" error instead of failing silently.
Parallel worker-completion notifications are coalesced into one turn.
drainSessionMailbox.why: drainSessionMailbox is the caller of the new isMergeableDrainBatch that merges worker notify deliveries into one turn.

encodePiWorkerFrame.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
encodePiWorkerFrame.why: Frames messages written to the pi worker stdin; only createPiWorkerAdapter uses it.

enforceContractGate.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
enforceContractGate.why: Returns the gate verdicts no-contract / parse-fail / partition-absent / kind-not-consumed / valid for a signal kind against a partition contract.

enqueueSessionCompactCommand.changelog: `duoduo session compact` — compact a channel session's context on demand. Queue a `/compact` for any channel session by key or name; it runs on that session's next turn ... Channel sessions only.
enqueueSessionCompactCommand.why: Implements session.compact: resolves the session by key or alias, refuses non-channel kinds (forbidden_kind), ingests "/compact" into its mailbox and wakes it.

ensureAgentsMdSymlink.why: Creates the AGENTS.md symlink to CLAUDE.md, logged under [codex].

ensureOutboxRecordInReplay.changelog: **runtime**: Split outbox replay bootstrap read/write paths so live appends no longer rebuild replay artifacts on every write.
ensureOutboxRecordInReplay.why: Write path that appends a record to replay only when the by_id index lacks it, under a per-session lock, separate from the read/bootstrap path.

ensureSessionMailboxPendingDir.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
ensureSessionMailboxPendingDir.why: Creates mailbox/pending/ for the per-item mailbox.

evaluateNotifyConsumerRefusal.changelog: **Notify refuses a session nobody reads.** Delivering into a foreground session whose last consumer take is older than `ALADUO_NOTIFY_UNCONSUMED_HOURS` (default off until set) now fails
evaluateNotifyConsumerRefusal.why: For a "channel" target, decides refusal from classifyConsumerStaleness and lists sessions with a recent consumer.

executeGatewayCommand.changelog: On a Claude model without `max` support the request runs as `high`, and the `/effort max` reply says so.
executeGatewayCommand.why: The /effort reply text " On a model without max support the Claude SDK runs it as high." appears first in v0.8.3.

expandInjectionPromptCommand.changelog: The recurring `/loop` capability is now one entry in a general mechanism for named prompt injections, with a self-describing `duoduo prompts` CLI to list what's available.
expandInjectionPromptCommand.why: Expands a matched named prompt into prompt text plus the user args.

extractCodexGeneratedImageAttachment.changelog: Runtime image output delivery no longer duplicates attachments.
extractCodexGeneratedImageAttachment.why: Turns a Codex imageGeneration item into an image/png outbound attachment, the runtime image output path (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)
The Codex image attachment extractor changed in the same release that added hasImageGenerationRecord.

extractProfiledEndpointFields.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
extractProfiledEndpointFields.why: Extracts the endpoint and credential fields from a "profiled-external" requirement ("its own endpoint and credential").

extractServedModelFromUsage.changelog: The dashboard and the usage ledger record the model that actually served each turn, not the one that was requested
extractServedModelFromUsage.why: Takes the model reported in the turn's usage (ignoring "default") as the served model.

extractSystemPromptAppend.changelog: feat(codex): Codex app-server adapter (Phase 1) for running job sessions on GPT-5.4
extractSystemPromptAppend.why: Only caller is createCodexAppServerAdapter, which uses it to take the Claude system-prompt append for Codex.

filterDeliverableSessions.changelog: `session.list` accepts `deliverable: true` to list only the sessions a `Notify` would deliver to.
filterDeliverableSessions.why: Keeps only sessions for which evaluateNotifyConsumerRefusal (the Notify refusal check) does not refuse; called when session.list gets deliverable.

findDeadAllowedToolEntries.changelog: a startup warning flags any descriptor still relying on the old behavior.
findDeadAllowedToolEntries.why: Finds non-mcp__ tool entries not in the core set; createAgentSdkAdapter warns "move them to the descriptor's claude: { tools: [...] }".

findEventInPartitionFile.changelog: Readers that miss it fall back to the day's log partition, so nothing becomes unreadable — and `duoduo spine show <id>` falls back to a full scan.
findEventInPartitionFile.why: Scans one day partition file line by line for an event id, the fallback a reader takes when the bounded index misses.

findNewestFragmentMtimeMs.why: Finds the newest memory/fragments mtime, compared against the intuition-weaver's last run.

fireDueWakeRecords.changelog: A session can schedule its own next turn.
fireDueWakeRecords.why: Cadence step that fires due wake records ("self-wake", "wake:") into the target session via deliverRouteEventToSession.

forgetMemoryEntry.changelog: `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET=1` additionally lets it remove long-stale, board-unreachable orphan nodes (git-recoverable).
forgetMemoryEntry.why: Removes STALE orphan nodes via git rm (--cached/--ignore-unmatch) and commits "forget: ... stale orphan memory nodes", i.e. git-recoverable removal.

formatElapsedDuration.changelog: **runner**: Add configurable time-gap session context and upgrade runtime prompt assembly to structured content blocks.
formatElapsedDuration.why: Formats the elapsed time (" day", " hours", " minute") that renderTimeGapContextBlock puts into the time-gap block; its only role is that block.

formatForgetCommitMessage.changelog: `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET=1` additionally lets it remove long-stale, board-unreachable orphan nodes (git-recoverable).
formatForgetCommitMessage.why: Builds the "forget: N stale orphan memory nodes" commit message for the git-recoverable removal.

formatLayerModelAliases.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
formatLayerModelAliases.why: Turns a layer's alias map into {tier, model, source} rows, i.e. tier aliases per config layer.

formatLocalTimestampWithZone.changelog: Time annotations injected into `<time-context>`, `<job-tick>`, and `<skip-rewind>` prompt blocks now include a daemon wall-clock alongside the UTC timestamp on host-mode deployments
formatLocalTimestampWithZone.why: Formats a local date/time with zone offset and name; called by renderTimeGapContextBlock, renderJobTickBlock and renderSkipRewindBlock (all changed in 0.5.0)

formatViewSessionsListLine.why: Formats one session line of the ViewSessions list; its "orphan — job archived…" literal already existed in v0.8.1 (predecessor under ManageSession).

getCachedPartitionContract.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
getCachedPartitionContract.why: Caches readPartitionContract results for the delivery layer.

grokAcpExtMethod.changelog: It sits behind the same seam as Claude and Codex rather than beside it
grokAcpExtMethod.why: Builds Grok ACP extension method names from GROK_ACP_EXT_PREFIX ("_x.ai"), used for compact and MCP calls.

groupNotifyTargetCandidates.changelog: Notify "target not found" error now matches candidates scope-aware (session_key prefix + channel kind)
groupNotifyTargetCandidates.why: Groups notify candidates by scope before rendering (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

handleDrainError.changelog: the runner now writes a `[duoduo:drain-error]` outbox reply to the anchor event's channel and a matching `agent.error` spine event, instead of silently dropping the turn.
handleDrainError.why: Literal "[duoduo:drain-error] agent turn failed at" and appends an agent.error spine event (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

handlePiToolEndObservation.changelog: Fourth peer behind the same seam as the other three: duoduo's own tools reachable from it
handlePiToolEndObservation.why: On a pi tool end it parses result details and runs runQueueOutboundAttachmentTool, so a duoduo tool called from pi takes effect.

hasAnyMemorySignalConsumer.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
hasAnyMemorySignalConsumer.why: Asks enforceContractGate whether any partition contract consumes a signal kind before the tick produces it.

hasImageGenerationRecord.changelog: Generated images produced by Codex were sometimes silently dropped; they are now delivered correctly, including the newer inline-image result shape.
hasImageGenerationRecord.why: Searches nested payload/event/msg/item objects for an image-generation item, tolerating several result shapes.

hasNonEmptyDisplayName.changelog: `duoduo session alias <key> "<name>"` — give a session a human label so it is legible in `list` and usable as a wake target.
hasNonEmptyDisplayName.why: Tests for a non-empty display name; used by alias set and alias resolution

hasParentToolUseId.changelog: Internal subagent streaming output is now marked as a side channel and dropped by channels rather than rendered into the main reply.
hasParentToolUseId.why: Tests parent_tool_use_id, the field that marks a message as subagent output; the literal first appears in 0.5.7 and the callers are the Claude adapters.

hasSkipRewindRecordSince.changelog: The skip-rewind injection only fires on genuine human turns, not on periodic cadence pings.
hasSkipRewindRecordSince.why: Reads pending_skip_rewind.skipped_at from session runtime state to decide whether a skip-rewind record applies.

hasUniformDrainCoalesceKey.changelog: Parallel worker-completion notifications are coalesced into one turn.
hasUniformDrainCoalesceKey.why: Checks that all items of a candidate batch share one computeDrainCoalesceKey value, the condition isMergeableDrainBatch uses to coalesce worker notifications.

hostDotEnvPath.changelog: fix(daemon): forward ANTHROPIC_* env and apply onboard state on upgrade
hostDotEnvPath.why: Path ~/.config/duoduo/.env where the onboard state is stored and from which the daemon applies it.

initActivationLintModule.changelog: On top of that sits an activation report: it counts which memories are actually being read during real work, so the pipeline gets told about dead weight and unreachable material instead of accumulating both silently.
initActivationLintModule.why: Module initialiser of the activation lint, routing it to "intuition-weaver" and listing write tool names whose touches are excluded.

initBoardTransclusionModule.changelog: injects the rendered import graph into both Claude and Codex sessions through one path.
initBoardTransclusionModule.why: Defines the allowed include file extensions and the " (project instructions, checked into the codebase)" heading suffix used by the transclusion

initBroadcastFlattenLintModule.changelog: The single memory weaver is now two partitions with separate jobs — one distils raw experience into fragments, one consolidates them into intuition.
initBroadcastFlattenLintModule.why: Re-targets the existing "[memory:claude-flatten]" lint to the new "intuition-weaver" partition (the lint itself is from v0.5.5).

initBroadcastLinkLintModule.changelog: The single memory weaver is now two partitions with separate jobs — one distils raw experience into fragments, one consolidates them into intuition.
initBroadcastLinkLintModule.why: Re-targets the existing "[memory:claude-lint]" lint to the new "intuition-weaver" partition (the lint itself is from v0.5.5).

initCallerSessionEnvModule.changelog: **`duoduo session notify` inside a session sends as that session.** Run from a session's own shell, the message is recorded with that session as the sender, as the `Notify` tool already did
initCallerSessionEnvModule.why: Defines ALADUO_CALLER_SESSION, which the Claude spawn env sets per session and deliverExternalSessionNotify reads to record the calling session as sender (error text mentions the --source label).

initChannelProtocolModule.changelog: A new runtime value, `void`, for channel plugins whose sessions never run a model. A message to a void session is written to the spine and the outbox and wakes nothing.
initChannelProtocolModule.why: The runtime value list now contains "void".

initFoldGapLintModule.why: Initialiser routing the fold-gap signal to "intuition-weaver".

initGapLintModule.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
initGapLintModule.why: Initialiser holding "scan-gap.md.pending", "gap-handed-days.txt" and the external event types (channel.message, external.record) the distiller is pointed at.

initGrokAcpRuntimeModule.changelog: one long-lived agent process per session, duoduo's own tools reachable from it
initGrokAcpRuntimeModule.why: Defines the Grok MCP meta keys "x.ai/mcp/servers", "x.ai/mcp/sdk", "mcp/sdk_call" with server name "aladuo", through which duoduo's tools reach Grok.

initInterruptMarkerTextModule.changelog: **The model is told when a human ended its turn**, instead of the turn simply stopping and the next one starting from a gap it cannot explain.
initInterruptMarkerTextModule.why: Defines the marker texts "[Request interrupted by user]" and "[Tool call did not complete: the turn was ended to deliver the message that foll…".

initMaterializedClaudeSettingsModule.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
initMaterializedClaudeSettingsModule.why: Lists the env keys materialized into a per-session Claude settings file: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (endpoint and credential), ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL (tier aliases) and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS (context window).

initMemorySignalDeliveryModule.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
initMemorySignalDeliveryModule.why: Defines the delivery layer constants: partition ids (memory-weaver, pattern-tracker, ...) and .memory-signals.json.

initMemorySignalKindsModule.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
initMemorySignalKindsModule.why: Defines the versioned signal kinds (orphan-islands.v1, node-converge.v1, scan-gap.v2, ...) that contracts declare.

initMetaSessionModule.changelog: The single memory weaver is now two partitions with separate jobs — one distils raw experience into fragments, one consolidates them into intuition.
initMetaSessionModule.why: Assigns the two new partition names "gradient-distiller" and "intuition-weaver".

initNotifyConsumerStalenessModule.changelog: Delivering into a foreground session whose last consumer take is older than `ALADUO_NOTIFY_UNCONSUMED_HOURS` (default off until set) now fails
initNotifyConsumerStalenessModule.why: Defines the env key "ALADUO_NOTIFY_UNCONSUMED_HOURS" and the "delivery_cursors" store it reads.

initPartitionRetirementModule.changelog: The `memory-weaver` subconscious partition is **replaced** by two partitions. Existing partition prompts are never overwritten by an upgrade, so nothing changes until you refresh them
initPartitionRetirementModule.why: Declares "memory-weaver" (and "cadence-executor") as retired partitions with a ".retired" marker.

initPartitionRunStateModule.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
initPartitionRunStateModule.why: Module initialiser of the partition run-state module that holds the backoff constants.

initProtocolEffortModule.changelog: **Model and effort from the CLI.** `duoduo session model` / `duoduo session effort` inspect or set a channel session's model and reasoning effort without going through the chat
initProtocolEffortModule.why: Defines the effort level enum ("low".."max") that isSessionEffortParams validates against for the new session effort RPC.

initProtocolSystemModule.changelog: `spine.record` appends an `external.record` event for writers outside duoduo, with optional per-source deduplication.
initProtocolSystemModule.why: Protocol constants module that lists the new RPC methods spine.record, spine.cat and memory.read with their param keys (dedup_key, conversation, count_only).

initRemindDuoduoToolModule.why: Defines the tool "RemindDuoduo" ("mcp__aladuo__RemindDuoduo") with the description "Schedule one future turn of this session".

initRuntimeValidationModule.changelog: After the upgrade an unknown value in `ALADUO_DEFAULT_RUNTIME` stops the daemon from booting (an absent or empty value still means `claude`).
initRuntimeValidationModule.why: Defines InvalidRuntimeError and the quoted list formatter used in the refusal text; resolveDefaultRuntime (changed in 0.8.4) throws on an invalid ALADUO_DEFAULT_RUNTIME.

initSessionLockAndArchivingModule.changelog: Concurrent `channel.ack` during archive refused at entry: prevents delivery-cursor writers from creating files beside a just-renamed session dir; observer re-read is now wrapped in the per-session state lock and re-checks the archiving marker after the lock is taken.
initSessionLockAndArchivingModule.why: Defines SessionArchivingError with code session_archiving and message "Session is being archived; refusing to materialize state" (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

initSpineEventLogModule.changelog: The by-id index is now a bounded recency cache keyed on event date and compacted at boot (`ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS`, 7 days by default).
initSpineEventLogModule.why: Assigns the literal "ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS", the env var the entry names.

initViewSessionsToolModule.why: Defines the tool "ViewSessions" ("mcp__aladuo__ViewSessions"), "Read-only view of the sessions this daemon runs."

initVoidRuntimeModule.why: Holds "This session never runs a model (runtime void).", the refusal createModelCommandResolvers (changed) returns for model commands on a void session.

isAgentRuntime.changelog: From v0.8.4 the value is refused with a sentence that names it and lists the valid ones.
isAgentRuntime.why: Protocol-side test that a value is in the full runtime list (void included); isKnownRuntimeValue delegates to it.

isAutoArchivedJobSchedule.changelog: fix(job): wire system-level notify delivery and fix child job routing (9e7b13b)
isAutoArchivedJobSchedule.why: In 0.4.0 this once/@in predicate is what classifyJobScheduleType called to choose the one-shot fallback notification.

isBoardIncludePathCandidate.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself

isChannelDescribeParams.changelog: new `channel.describe` / `channel.spawn` RPCs expose the instance lifecycle to channel plugins.
isChannelDescribeParams.why: Param validator for channel.describe (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

isChannelMessageEvent.changelog: A message you send while the agent is mid-turn on something it started by itself now gets its own turn.
isChannelMessageEvent.why: Tests type "channel.message", the user-message class classifyDrainBatchClass separates.

isChannelPullParams.changelog: `channel.pull` accepts `advance: "ack"`: the stream pushes records as before, and only `channel.ack` moves the consumer's cursor.

isChannelSpawnParams.changelog: new `channel.describe` / `channel.spawn` RPCs expose the instance lifecycle to channel plugins.
isChannelSpawnParams.why: Param validator for channel.spawn (checks runtime via isAgentRuntime) (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

isChannelSpawnParams.changelog: `channel.spawn` takes an optional `session_key` and creates that session bound to the channel.
isChannelSpawnParams.why: Accepts the new optional session_key parameter.

isClaudeAuthSource.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
isClaudeAuthSource.why: Recognises the auth sources "claude_code_local", "anthropic_api_key", "compatible_endpoint" of the onboarding auth flow.

isClaudeAvailable.changelog: Hosts can expose whichever runtimes are actually installed and authenticated.
isClaudeAvailable.why: Reads the cached probe; consumed by the runtime list offered to jobs/setup

isGrokSkipToolCall.changelog: duoduo's own tools reachable from it
isGrokSkipToolCall.why: Detects a call to duoduo's Skip tool in a Grok tool call (via collectGrokToolCallNames).

isJobInterruptParams.changelog: `duoduo job list | read | archive | interrupt | reschedule`. Interrupting carries a reason
isJobInterruptParams.why: Params validator of the RPC "job.interrupt" (method absent before v0.8.2); name from published @openduo/protocol job.ts.

isJobRescheduleParams.changelog: `duoduo job list | read | archive | interrupt | reschedule`.
isJobRescheduleParams.why: Params validator of the RPC "job.reschedule" (method absent before v0.8.2).

isJobScheduleDue.changelog: The loop runs as a job, paces itself via `ScheduleWakeup`
isJobScheduleDue.why: CHAIN MIS-STEP: this function already existed in 0.5.5 (4 params); in 0.5.6 it gains a 5th re-arm-time parameter that makes a re-armed once/@in job due, matching the self-pacing loop.

isKnownRuntimeValue.changelog: From v0.8.4 the value is refused with a sentence that names it and lists the valid ones.
isKnownRuntimeValue.why: The membership test validateKnownRuntimeValue uses to decide whether a written runtime value is known.

isLoopbackBindHost.changelog: The remote listener starts only when a host, a port and a token are all present, and every request must carry the token. A misconfigured remote setup — a public address with no token, or a port colliding with the read-only one — refuses to start rather than exposing anything.
isLoopbackBindHost.why: Classifies the bind host as loopback ("localhost", "::1"), which resolveRemoteListenerConfig uses to tell a public address (token required) from a local one.

isMergeableDrainBatch.changelog: Parallel worker-completion notifications are coalesced into one turn.
isMergeableDrainBatch.why: Allows a drain batch of >=2 items to merge into one turn when all are worker-task notify deliveries (or all channel messages) sharing one coalesce key.

isModelRuntime.changelog: `void` is not accepted as the default runtime, a job runtime or a partition runtime, and should not be set on an ordinary chat channel.
isModelRuntime.why: Protocol-side test that a value is one of the model runtimes (the four engines without void); isSupportedRuntime delegates to it.

isOneShotJobSchedule.changelog: **Job `keepalive` schedule type** (#44): a new cron value that runs once then keeps its session dormant.
isOneShotJobSchedule.why: Treats "keepalive" like once/@in as a run-once schedule.

isOrphanWarningDeliverable.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
isOrphanWarningDeliverable.why: Checks via enforceContractGate that the orphan-warning signal kind is declared by its partition before delivery.

isPartitionBackedOff.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
isPartitionBackedOff.why: Lets the partition scheduler skip a partition that is in backoff when picking the next one.

isProviderQualifiedModelId.changelog: a job naming a model pi cannot run is refused when you create it, not when it next fires.
isProviderQualifiedModelId.why: Tests for a provider/model id (pi's model form); runManageJobTool calls it when a job is created.

isSessionArchiveParams.changelog: `session.archive` RPC + `duoduo session archive <session_key>` CLI retired the old ad-hoc deletion paths.
isSessionArchiveParams.why: Param validator (session_key string) for the session.archive RPC (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

isSessionArchiving.changelog: re-checks the archiving marker after the lock is taken.
isSessionArchiving.why: Reads the archiving marker (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

isSessionCompactParams.changelog: `duoduo session compact` — compact a channel session's context on demand.
isSessionCompactParams.why: Validates the params of the session.compact RPC.

isSessionConfigParams.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
isSessionConfigParams.why: Session-config RPC validator accepting the new verbs "profile_set", "profile_unset", "profile_alias_set", "profile_alias_unset".

isSessionEffortParams.changelog: **Model and effort from the CLI.** `duoduo session model` / `duoduo session effort` inspect or set a channel session's model and reasoning effort without going through the chat
isSessionEffortParams.why: RPC param validator for { session_key, effort } checked with isEffortLevel, behind `duoduo session effort`.

isSessionListParams.changelog: `duoduo session list [--kind …] [--named] [--all] [--json]` — the live route table of every session the daemon knows.
isSessionListParams.why: Validates kind plus boolean flags for the session.list RPC behind the command

isSessionListParams.changelog: `session.list` accepts `deliverable: true` to list only the sessions a `Notify` would deliver to.

isSessionModelParams.changelog: **Model and effort from the CLI.** `duoduo session model` / `duoduo session effort` inspect or set a channel session's model and reasoning effort without going through the chat
isSessionModelParams.why: RPC param validator for { session_key, model }, the request shape behind `duoduo session model`.

isSessionNotifyParams.why: Param validator for the session.notify RPC

isSessionSetAliasParams.changelog: `duoduo session alias <key> "<name>"` — give a session a human label so it is legible in `list` and usable as a wake target.
isSessionSetAliasParams.why: Param validator (key + name strings) for the alias RPC

isSpineTailParams.changelog: **protocol**: Add `system.status` RPC (health, sessions, subconscious playlist) and `spine.tail` RPC (last N events with incremental `after_id` cursor and cross-midnight boundary support).
isSpineTailParams.why: Validator for the spine.tail params (a number limit, an optional string cursor).

isSupportedRuntime.changelog: `void` is not accepted as the default runtime, a job runtime or a partition runtime, and should not be set on an ordinary chat channel.
isSupportedRuntime.why: Tests a value against the model-running runtimes; validateRunnableRuntimeValue and buildJobRuntimeSchemaField use it to exclude void.

isSystemRuntimeInfo.changelog: **daemon**: Expose runtime version in `system.runtime.info` RPC and ATC dashboard.
isSystemRuntimeInfo.why: Validator of the system.runtime.info response, which carries a version field and changed in this release.

isSystemRuntimeInfo.changelog: feat: add `kernel_dir` to `system.runtime.info` for contrib path discovery
isSystemRuntimeInfo.why: The system.runtime.info validator contains kernel_dir and changed in this release.

isTelemetryEnabled.changelog: **`ALADUO_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` env var**: set to `false` to disable `var/telemetry/*.jsonl` file persistence while keeping in-process debug telemetry logs intact.
isTelemetryEnabled.why: Reads ALADUO_TELEMETRY_ENABLED (default true); recordTelemetryMetric skips the file write when it is false.

isUsableEventIndexEntry.changelog: guards the by-id index against out-of-range lookups.
isUsableEventIndexEntry.why: Accepts a by-id index entry only if byte_offset is a safe integer >= 0 and byte_len > 0.

isVoidRuntimeSession.changelog: A new runtime value, `void`, for channel plugins whose sessions never run a model. A message to a void session is written to the spine and the outbox and wakes nothing.
isVoidRuntimeSession.why: Returns true when a session's resolved channel runtime is "void"; used to skip attaching and to list void sessions.

isWorkerTaskNotifyDelivery.changelog: Parallel worker-completion notifications are coalesced into one turn.
isWorkerTaskNotifyDelivery.why: Recognises a route.deliver event whose source_event_type is "notify" and whose payload has a task_id, i.e. a worker-completion notification; absent from 0.5.4.

iteratePartitionLinesBackward.why: Yields lines of a partition file backwards in blksize chunks (readPartitionByteRange).

iterateStreamLines.changelog: Log lines containing U+2028 were shredded on read, because the line reader treated it as a line break and JSON does not.
iterateStreamLines.why: A new streaming line reader (own splitter instead of readline) used by the index prune and partition fallback scans; the fix replaced the reader that split on U+2028.

listArchivedCopiesNewestFirst.changelog: `discoverChannelId` prefers the newest archive during retry: partial-archive retries now resolve the owning channel from the freshest archived state.json rather than an orphaned bare-ref stub.
listArchivedCopiesNewestFirst.why: Lists the bare ref and collision-suffixed archive copies sorted by existence then mtime, newest first (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

listEventPartitionDates.changelog: The activation window counts days on which someone actually interacted, so a quiet week no longer ages memories out.
listEventPartitionDates.why: Lists var/events partition dates for scanActivationWindowTouches to pick the window days.

listMailboxPendingItems.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
listMailboxPendingItems.why: Lists mailbox/pending/*.item.json: the mailbox is now one file per pending item instead of a rewritten markdown list.

listMemoryFragmentDates.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
listMemoryFragmentDates.why: Lists dates of memory/fragments, the output of the distilling partition, to seed handed days.

listSelectableJobRuntimes.changelog: `ManageJob` also always exposes the effective `runtime` field.
listSelectableJobRuntimes.why: Builds the runtime enum for buildJobRuntimeSchemaField (ManageJob schema) from availability probes, falling back to claude

listSelectableJobRuntimes.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
listSelectableJobRuntimes.why: Always pushes "pi" into the selectable job runtimes.

listSessionIndexSummaries.changelog: `session.list` accepts `deliverable: true` to list only the sessions a `Notify` would deliver to.
listSessionIndexSummaries.why: Applies n.deliverable ? await filterDeliverableSessions(...) to the session.list result; the rest of the body existed in 0.8.3 (see suspectChain).
listSessionIndexSummaries.note: the release chain may have lost an older body of this symbol; the entry describes a change, not its first appearance

listSessionsWithRecentConsumer.changelog: now fails with a message naming the sessions that *do* have a reader
listSessionsWithRecentConsumer.why: Lists "channel" sessions whose latest delivery-cursor update is within the window.

listSortedAliasKeys.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
listSortedAliasKeys.why: Lists the keys of a model-alias map, the "tier aliases" part of a model declaration.

listVoidChannelSessions.why: Called only by runSpineCatRpc under redact: "external" to collect channel sessions whose runtime is void.

loadChannelKindConfig.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
loadChannelKindConfig.why: Its v0.7.0 body records claudeModelProfileIssues and "claude.model_aliases" issues for a channel-kind file (a [channel-config] predecessor existed in v0.6.2).

loadGlobalRuntimeConfig.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
loadGlobalRuntimeConfig.why: Loads the global runtime config file with parseClaudeFrontmatterBlock and records claude.model_aliases issues.

loadHostDotEnv.changelog: fix(daemon): forward ANTHROPIC_* env and apply onboard state on upgrade
loadHostDotEnv.why: Daemon-side load of the host .env at boot, which is how onboard state reaches the daemon after an upgrade.

lookupEventIdIndexEntry.changelog: guards the by-id index against out-of-range lookups.
lookupEventIdIndexEntry.why: By-id lookup returning null "as an index miss" on load failure and checking isIndexLoadStillCurrent; a v0.8.1 predecessor with the same log text existed.

lookupInjectionPrompt.changelog: The recurring `/loop` capability is now one entry in a general mechanism for named prompt injections, with a self-describing `duoduo prompts` CLI to list what's available.
lookupInjectionPrompt.why: Looks a name up in the registry object of named prompt injections.

lookupOutboxByIdIndexEntry.changelog: **replay**: Harden session-local cursor fallback and recovery when replay indexes are incomplete or stale.
lookupOutboxByIdIndexEntry.why: Index lookup that the cursor fallback consults before falling back to a scan.

main.changelog: The by-id index is now a bounded recency cache keyed on event date and compacted at boot (`ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS`, 7 days by default).

mapClaudeResultToDrainUsage.changelog: The footer also shows which model was actually billed (served model may differ from the requested model). The footer reflects per-turn deltas, not process-global accumulators.
mapClaudeResultToDrainUsage.why: Computes total_cost_usd as the delta against prevTotalCostUsd and picks the billed model from the modelUsage delta: per-turn cost and served model.

mapClaudeResultToDrainUsage.changelog: A resumed turn now reports its own figures. A session that existed before the upgrade has no saved baseline yet, so its first resume shows no cost and no model.
mapClaudeResultToDrainUsage.why: Uses prevTotalCostUsd / baselineUnknown to report a resumed turn's own cost.

mapGrokUsageToDrainUsage.changelog: Token and cache accounting understands Grok's own reporting shape, so cost numbers stay comparable across the three.
mapGrokUsageToDrainUsage.why: Converts Grok's usage object into the drain usage record tagged "grok".

matchNearMissSessionKey.changelog: Notify "target not found" error now matches candidates scope-aware (session_key prefix + channel kind), yielding actionable suggestions.
matchNearMissSessionKey.why: Literals "matches in a different scope", "last segment differs by N char", "hash differs — job may have been recreated" (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

materializeClaudeSettingsFile.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
materializeClaudeSettingsFile.why: Writes the per-model settings file (writeFileAtomic of buildClaudeSettingsEnvOverrides) that carries the endpoint, credential and window.

memoizeAvailabilityProbeUntilOk.changelog: A failed check is no longer remembered either: the next message checks again, so installing Codex takes effect without a restart.
memoizeAvailabilityProbeUntilOk.why: Caches an availability probe promise but resets the cache when the result is not ok or the probe throws.

mergeClaudeToolLists.changelog: anything else ... is off unless explicitly added via a new nested `claude.tools` key in a channel's kind or instance descriptor.
mergeClaudeToolLists.why: Unions two tool lists, used to combine kind and instance claude.tools entries.

mergeContiguousHourRanges.changelog: It now works one bounded day at a time, picked by a program-computed gap check (`duoduo memory check` reports the chosen gap)
mergeContiguousHourRanges.why: Only caller is runGapLint; it merges contiguous hour indices into ranges, the gap computation.

mergeGlobalModelConfigLayers.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
mergeGlobalModelConfigLayers.why: Overlays model profile entries from "global" and "instance" layers, tagging each with its source layer.

mergeInboxIntoMailbox.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
mergeInboxIntoMailbox.why: Moves inbox files into mailbox/pending/*.item.json (with quarantine on parse failure), the ingest half of the per-item mailbox.

mergeOutboundAttachmentLists.changelog: Runtime image output delivery no longer duplicates attachments.
mergeOutboundAttachmentLists.why: Merges attachment lists de-duplicated by the key path+NUL+mime (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

mergeRuntimeEffortLayers.changelog: Reasoning effort gets the same global → kind → instance layering as the model
mergeRuntimeEffortLayers.why: Folds per-runtime effort maps over the ordered layers, same shape as mergeRuntimeModelLayers.

mergeRuntimeModelLayers.changelog: globally or per channel kind or per channel instance, with the most specific layer winning.
mergeRuntimeModelLayers.why: Folds per-runtime model maps over the ordered layers (foldConfigLayersByKey), later layers overwriting earlier ones.

moveSessionDirToArchive.changelog: **Archive session tombstone** (#44): `ManageJob(archive)` now moves the session directory to `var/sessions-archive/`
moveSessionDirToArchive.why: Moves the session directory into the archive directory.

mutateSessionRuntimeState.changelog: `updateSessionRuntimeState`, and `enqueueMailboxItem` now take the same lock that `archiveSessionDir` takes.
mutateSessionRuntimeState.why: state.json writer that runs inside runWithSessionMutex and calls assertSessionNotArchiving (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

normalizeBoardIncludeToken.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself
normalizeBoardIncludeToken.why: Drops #fragment and unescapes spaces in an include token

normalizeChannelCapabilityDeclarations.changelog: **daemon**: Per-consumer channel capabilities to prevent overwrite race ([#7](https://github.com/openduo/duoduo/issues/7)).
normalizeChannelCapabilityDeclarations.why: Converts a single legacy declaration (with declared_at) into a map keyed by declared_by, i.e. capabilities stored per consumer.

normalizeIncludePathKey.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself and injects the rendered import graph
normalizeIncludePathKey.why: Case-folds include paths on win32 for de-duplication inside resolveBoardIncludes

normalizeInputTokenTotals.changelog: Every finalized turn now appends a one-line footer: `↑ in · cache% · ↓ out · $cost` for Claude turns
normalizeInputTokenTotals.why: Normalises total and cached input tokens per protocol, the two numbers a cache% figure needs.

normalizeNotifyChannelTarget.changelog: Job results went nowhere when the job had no explicit audience; the owner is now the default, and a job can no longer disappear without a trace.
normalizeNotifyChannelTarget.why: Normalises a job's owner_session into a route target; used by resolveJobOwnerNotifyTarget and createJobSessionFinalizer to deliver results to the owner.

normalizeReturnMask.changelog: fix(daemon): add `stream_end` to pull stream return_mask whitelist (#40)
normalizeReturnMask.why: The return_mask normaliser contains "stream_end" and changed in this release.

normalizeSignalKindVersion.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
normalizeSignalKindVersion.why: Normalises a declared signal kind to its .v1 versioned form for comparison in the contract.

normalizeTurnAbortReason.changelog: The model is told when a human ended its turn
normalizeTurnAbortReason.why: Keeps only the abort reasons "user-cancel" and "preempt" that decide which marker is shown.

parseBoardFileContent.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself
parseBoardFileContent.why: Strips frontmatter and HTML comments then calls collectBoardIncludePaths

parseChannelConfigFields.changelog: enable and tune per conversation with `duoduo session config <session> set auto_compact_idle_minutes=50 auto_compact_min_context_tokens=100000`.
parseChannelConfigFields.why: Parses auto_compact_idle_minutes and auto_compact_min_context_tokens from a channel descriptor.

parseChannelRuntimeField.changelog: In a channel kind or instance descriptor it refuses the turns of the sessions that layer selects; a valid instance value still overrides an unknown kind value.
parseChannelRuntimeField.why: Validates a channel config's runtime with validateKnownRuntimeValue("This channel's config") and keeps the result as runtimeRefusal instead of dropping it.

parseClaudeFrontmatterBlock.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
parseClaudeFrontmatterBlock.why: Parses the claude: frontmatter block ("claude-block-malformed") that holds model_profiles and model_aliases.

parseDotEnv.changelog: **cli**: Host-side `.env` file support — daemon command auto-loads dotenv before starting.
parseDotEnv.why: A dotenv parser; the entry names .env support, and its callers (loadHostDotEnv, readHostDotEnvFile) read the host .env.

parseInjectionPromptCommand.changelog: The recurring `/loop` capability is now one entry in a general mechanism for named prompt injections, with a self-describing `duoduo prompts` CLI to list what's available.
parseInjectionPromptCommand.why: Parses "/<name> args" and looks the name up in the injection-prompt registry, returning {name, prompt, usage, args}.

parseInputJsonDelta.changelog: **runner**: Expose `tool_input_delta` in `session.execution` notifications for progressive tool input rendering.
parseInputJsonDelta.why: Parses content_block_delta events of type "input_json_delta", the stream fragments of a tool's input that become tool_input_delta.

parseJobFileFrontmatter.changelog: A job's frontmatter now accepts `prompt_mode`, `allowedTools`, `disallowedTools`, `additionalDirectories` and a nested `claude: { tools }`
parseJobFileFrontmatter.why: The job frontmatter parser now reads prompt_mode and allowedTools.

parseJobRearmTime.changelog: The loop runs as a job, paces itself via `ScheduleWakeup`
parseJobRearmTime.why: Parses a job re-arm time ("@in <duration>" or ISO timestamp, "Reschedule time is not in the future"), the self-pacing re-schedule of a job.

parseJobRearmTime.changelog: `@in` and `@every` now accept composite durations such as `2h30m` and `1d6h4m`. Invalid cron strings, malformed durations, and delays outside the representable time range are rejected when the job is created.
parseJobRearmTime.why: Re-arm parsing now goes through the composite parser and assertScheduleDurationRepresentable.

parsePartitionDefinition.changelog: In job frontmatter the job fails, and in partition frontmatter the partition is skipped.
parsePartitionDefinition.why: Now validates the partition frontmatter runtime with validateRunnableRuntimeValue, so a bad value skips the partition.

parsePiToolResultDetails.changelog: Fourth peer behind the same seam as the other three: duoduo's own tools reachable from it
parsePiToolResultDetails.why: Extracts the details object of a pi tool result for handlePiToolEndObservation.

parsePositiveMsEnv.changelog: Holding the input stream open across background-subagent continuations stops job and subconscious turns from hitting a "Stream closed" error.
parsePositiveMsEnv.why: In 0.5.8 its callers read ALADUO_HOLD_INPUT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS (new in 0.5.8) and ALADUO_ABORT_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS.

parseScheduleDurationMs.changelog: `@in` and `@every` now accept composite durations such as `2h30m` and `1d6h4m`. Invalid cron strings, malformed durations, and delays outside the representable time range are rejected when the job is created.
parseScheduleDurationMs.why: Sums every (\d+)([smhdw]) group so "2h30m" parses, and throws "Invalid duration format" unless the groups cover the whole string. CHAIN MIS-STEP: a single-unit predecessor with the same error literal existed through 0.6.0; this is a rewrite, not a new function.

parseSdkConfigFrontmatter.changelog: anything else ... is off unless explicitly added via a new nested `claude.tools` key in a channel's kind or instance descriptor.
parseSdkConfigFrontmatter.why: Parses allowedTools/disallowedTools and the nested claude block (parseClaudeFrontmatterBlock) from a descriptor.

parseToolUseBlockStart.changelog: **runner**: Expose `tool_input_delta` in `session.execution` notifications for progressive tool input rendering.
parseToolUseBlockStart.why: Parses content_block_start of type "tool_use" to know which tool the following input deltas belong to.

postMemorySignalsToInboxes.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
postMemorySignalsToInboxes.why: Before writing a .pending file into a partition inbox it calls enforceContractGate and skips non-valid kinds: the "validate before posting, withhold undeclared kinds" behaviour.
