prepareClaudeContextProfile.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
prepareClaudeContextProfile.why: Resolves the model profile and sets CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS through a materialized settings file for "profiled-external" models, logging under [claude-context-profile].

prepareDrainTurnContext.changelog: **session-manager**: Streaming turn admission control — new ingress enters a live CLI session without interrupting the active drain. When the CLI's result is delayed (e.g. background tasks polling), later messages are admitted into the same streaming session via a drain-scoped callback
prepareDrainTurnContext.why: Turn preparation (effective config, system prompt, transient blocks, coalesced prompt) factored out of the drain and called from both drainSessionMailbox and createSessionManager, so an admitted message can be prepared outside the original drain call.

prependPendingInterruptMarker.changelog: instead of the turn simply stopping and the next one starting from a gap it cannot explain.
prependPendingInterruptMarker.why: Injects the pending marker into the first message of the next turn's prompt stream, then clears it.

primeClaudeAvailability.changelog: Hosts can expose whichever runtimes are actually installed and authenticated.

primeCodexAvailability.changelog: The daemon now probes `codex --version` and `codex login status` at boot: if the CLI is installed and the user is logged in, codex is advertised
primeCodexAvailability.why: Boot-time call that caches checkCodexAvailability("codex") ok/reason (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

primeGrokAvailability.changelog: Availability is checked against the Grok CLI you already have installed
primeGrokAvailability.why: Primes the availability cache entry "grok" with checkGrokAvailability.

probeClaudeAvailability.changelog: Hosts can expose whichever runtimes are actually installed and authenticated. Claude remains the conservative fallback
probeClaudeAvailability.why: Probes the Claude native binary with a timeout and caches ok/reason, giving Claude the same availability probe Codex already had

probeSessionPendingWork.changelog: Archiving now refuses unless the session is provably empty of pending work (checking every shape of in-flight work), ignores channel placeholder actors, and treats the archive marker as a real "about to disappear" signal.
probeSessionPendingWork.why: Probes inbox .pending files, mailbox pointers and .item.json and returns clear / pending / unreadable; its callers are archiveSessionIfQuiescent and archiveSessionAndArtifacts.

pruneEventIdIndexByRetention.changelog: The by-id index is now a bounded recency cache keyed on event date and compacted at boot (`ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS`, 7 days by default).
pruneEventIdIndexByRetention.why: Rewrites the by-id index (resolveEventIdIndexPath, writeFileAtomic) keeping only entries whose partition date is inside retention; main calls it at boot.

readAllSessionStateFiles.changelog: feat(session): add readAllSessionStates() for scanning state.json files (c63683f)
readAllSessionStateFiles.why: Reads <sessionsDir>/*/state.json and returns them keyed by session_key, exactly what the entry names.

readClaudeAuthSourceEnv.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
readClaudeAuthSourceEnv.why: Reads the auth source from the environment, validated by isClaudeAuthSource.

readDrainLockFile.changelog: **runner**: Keep session lock heartbeat and release ownership inside the active drain so actors that never acquired the lock cannot renew or delete it.
readDrainLockFile.why: Reads the drain lock file so acquireSessionDrainLock and refreshSessionDrainLockHeartbeat can check who owns the lock before renewing it.

readEventAtIndexedOffset.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
readEventAtIndexedOffset.why: Reads only the event at an indexed byte offset in the partition file (lazy read).

readEventById.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
readEventById.why: Reads one event by id via the index offset and falls back to a partition scan, a lazy read instead of loading whole partitions.

readGapLintDayEvents.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
readGapLintDayEvents.why: Reads one day's event partition for runGapLint.

readGlobalUsageTotals.changelog: `usage.get` with `mode: "totals"` returns a single aggregate summary (~1KB vs ~230KB)
readGlobalUsageTotals.why: Aggregates all usage .jsonl records into one summary (its upstream name says Totals); called from createDaemon's RPC handlers.

readHostDaemonToken.changelog: The remote listener starts only when a host, a port and a token are all present, and every request must carry the token.
readHostDaemonToken.why: Reads DAEMON_TOKEN_ENV_KEY back from the host .env (ENOENT tolerated), the token the remote listener checks.

readHostDotEnvFile.changelog: fix(daemon): forward ANTHROPIC_* env and apply onboard state on upgrade
readHostDotEnvFile.why: Reads and parses the host .env; same onboard-state plumbing.

readIntuitionWeaverLastFinishedMs.why: Reads the intuition-weaver partition's last_finished_at run state for the fold-gap check.

readLatestDeliveryCursorUpdate.changelog: `duoduo daemon status` grew a block listing each channel session's last consumer take
readLatestDeliveryCursorUpdate.why: Reads the latest delivery-cursor record of a session, the "last consumer take" timestamp.

readOrSeedGapHandedDays.changelog: one distils raw experience into fragments
readOrSeedGapHandedDays.why: Reads or seeds gap-handed-days.txt from the existing memory/fragments dates.

readOrSetSessionEffort.changelog: **Model and effort from the CLI.** `duoduo session model` / `duoduo session effort` inspect or set a channel session's model and reasoning effort without going through the chat
readOrSetSessionEffort.why: Same shape as readOrSetSessionModel for "effort", restricted to "channel" sessions.

readOrSetSessionModel.changelog: **Model and effort from the CLI.** `duoduo session model` / `duoduo session effort` inspect or set a channel session's model and reasoning effort without going through the chat
readOrSetSessionModel.why: Resolves a session by key or alias, refuses non-channel kinds ("forbidden_kind") and archiving sessions, then reads or sets "model": a channel session's model from the CLI.

readOutboxRecordsPastCursor.changelog: **replay**: Harden session-local cursor fallback and recovery when replay indexes are incomplete or stale.
readOutboxRecordsPastCursor.why: Reads replay records past the consumer cursor, falls back to a scan strategy when the by_id index entry is missing or belongs to another session, and records strategy "bootstrapped"/"repair".

readPartitionByteRange.why: Reads one byte range of a partition file, the primitive of the bounded backward read.

readPartitionContract.changelog: Each subconscious partition declares which `.pending` signal kinds it consumes in its `contract:` frontmatter. The memory-check delivery layer validates the declaration before posting — an undeclared signal kind is withheld
readPartitionContract.why: Parses the partition's CLAUDE.md frontmatter contract and yields no-contract / parse-fail / self-id-mismatch / valid.

readPartitionRunState.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
readPartitionRunState.why: Reads the persisted per-partition run state the settled scheduler uses.

readPartitionTail.changelog: The dashboard streams usage summaries and bounds event tail reads.
readPartitionTail.why: Reads an event partition from the end with a line limit and cursor instead of loading the whole file.

readPiAgentSettings.changelog: A pi worker was torn down and rebuilt when its settings file merely failed to *read* — a transient error was treated as "not configured".
readPiAgentSettings.why: Reads pi's settings.json and sets readFailed only for errors other than ENOENT, separating "failed to read" from "not configured".

readRuntimeEffortSetting.changelog: Reasoning effort gets the same global → kind → instance layering as the model
readRuntimeEffortSetting.why: Reads the per-runtime effort default from a merged config layer.

readRuntimeModelSetting.changelog: Set a default model for Claude, Codex, pi or Grok, globally or per channel kind or per channel instance
readRuntimeModelSetting.why: Reads the per-runtime model default from a merged config layer.

readSpineIndexRetentionDays.changelog: The by-id index is now a bounded recency cache keyed on event date and compacted at boot (`ALADUO_SPINE_INDEX_RETENTION_DAYS`, 7 days by default).
readSpineIndexRetentionDays.why: Reads the retention-days setting and warns "[spine] ... is not a positive integer; using <default>", the 7-day default the entry describes.

readSpineTail.changelog: **protocol**: Add `system.status` RPC (health, sessions, subconscious playlist) and `spine.tail` RPC (last N events with incremental `after_id` cursor and cross-midnight boundary support).
readSpineTail.why: Reads the last N events from the dated .jsonl partitions (readPartitionTail), the implementation of spine.tail.

readStateSourceChannelId.changelog: partial-archive retries now resolve the owning channel from the freshest archived state.json
readStateSourceChannelId.why: Reads source_channel_id from a state.json file (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

realpathOrSelf.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself and injects the rendered import graph
realpathOrSelf.why: realpath with fallback used by resolveBoardIncludes for cycle/de-dup

reconcileMemorySignalInboxes.changelog: partition inboxes now have defined snapshot semantics, so a partition can no longer quietly lose or re-process work handed to it.
reconcileMemorySignalInboxes.why: Per partition, removes inbox files no longer pending and writes a sorted JSON snapshot of the pending filenames.

recordChannelCapabilityDeclaration.changelog: **daemon**: Per-consumer channel capabilities to prevent overwrite race ([#7](https://github.com/openduo/duoduo/issues/7)).
recordChannelCapabilityDeclaration.why: Writes capability declarations keyed by declared_by, changed in this release.

recordExternalSpineEvent.changelog: `spine.record` appends an `external.record` event for writers outside duoduo, with optional per-source deduplication.
recordExternalSpineEvent.why: Implements spine.record: validates params, checks a reserved source, dedups by computeDedupKey/registry and appends with createSpineEvent/atomicAppendEvent.

recordPendingInterruptMarker.changelog: The model is told when a human ended its turn
recordPendingInterruptMarker.why: Stores the selected marker on the session as pendingInterruptMarker after an abort.

recordTelemetryMetric.changelog: **`ALADUO_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` env var**: set to `false` to disable `var/telemetry/*.jsonl` file persistence

redactJobModelProfileTokens.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
redactJobModelProfileTokens.why: Redacts the claudeModelProfiles of a job frontmatter, which carry per-model credentials.

redactSpineEventForExternal.why: The redact hook for redact: "external": keeps only channel-session events, strips agent.tool_use/agent.tool_result to tool_name/is_error.

refreshSessionIndexEntry.changelog: give a session a human label so it is legible in `list`
refreshSessionIndexEntry.why: Re-reads meta and state to refresh one index entry after alias change

rehydrateSessionState.changelog: feat(session): reader fallback chain and session_key backfill (3fd1b1e)

resolveBoardIncludePath.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself

resolveBoardIncludes.why: Walks include paths recursively with realpath de-duplication to build the import graph

resolveChannelConfigBySession.changelog: A channel session that has sat idle past a configurable threshold and grown past a token floor now silently runs `/compact` on its next turn

resolveClaudeContextRequirement.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
resolveClaudeContextRequirement.why: Combines classifyModelContextRequirement with the profile issues for the model to produce the requirement the drain uses.

resolveClaudeCostBaseline.changelog: A resumed turn now reports its own figures. A session that existed before the upgrade has no saved baseline yet, so its first resume shows no cost and no model.

resolveCodexSandbox.why: Reads ALADUO_CODEX_SANDBOX and validates read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access.

resolveCodexSandboxForPermissionMode.why: Maps permission modes to a Codex sandbox value, the fallback when ALADUO_CODEX_SANDBOX is not set.

resolveContextCapToken.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
resolveContextCapToken.why: Maps the requirement kinds ("explicit-1m", "native-claude", "profiled-external") to the context-cap value used for the session.

resolveDefaultRuntime.changelog: it fails closed: asking for Grok when Grok is not usable gives you a clear error, never a silent fall back to Claude.
resolveDefaultRuntime.why: Its v0.7.1 body validates ALADUO_DEFAULT_RUNTIME with validateRunnableRuntimeValue and throws; the v0.7.0 predecessor silently returned "claude" for an unlisted value.

resolveDefaultRuntime.changelog: After the upgrade an unknown value in `ALADUO_DEFAULT_RUNTIME` stops the daemon from booting (an absent or empty value still means `claude`).
resolveDefaultRuntime.why: Now reads ALADUO_DEFAULT_RUNTIME through validateRunnableRuntimeValue and throws instead of falling back to claude.

resolveDrainContextProfileOrRefuse.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.
resolveDrainContextProfileOrRefuse.why: Calls prepareClaudeContextProfile before a turn and refuses it with "[duoduo:drain-error] agent turn refused before it started" and "Fix the offending claude.model_profiles entry".

resolveEnvConfigEntry.changelog: **daemon**: `system.config` RPC — inspect effective runtime configuration (network, sessions, cadence, SDK, paths) with source tracking (`env` / `default` / `unset`).
resolveEnvConfigEntry.why: Returns each entry with source "env", "default" or "unset" (and masks secrets as "***"), the source tracking the entry names.

resolveIsolatedPlaneKind.changelog: `duoduo session wake` refuses the kernel plane rather than accepting a target it cannot reach
resolveIsolatedPlaneKind.why: Returns the session kind unless it is "channel" or "job", i.e. names the isolated plane the wake refuses.

resolveJobOwnerNotifyTarget.changelog: Job results went nowhere when the job had no explicit audience; the owner is now the default, and a job can no longer disappear without a trace.
resolveJobOwnerNotifyTarget.why: Falls back to the job's owner_session via normalizeNotifyChannelTarget as the default Notify target.

resolveLayeredChannelRuntime.changelog: In a channel kind or instance descriptor it refuses the turns of the sessions that layer selects; a valid instance value still overrides an unknown kind value.
resolveLayeredChannelRuntime.why: Resolves runtime across instance, kind and default layers ("explicit"/"inherited"/"default") and carries a refusal through instead of falling to the next layer.

resolveMemoryCheckFlags.changelog: `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints; `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET=1` additionally lets it remove long-stale, board-unreachable orphan nodes (git-recoverable).
resolveMemoryCheckFlags.why: Reads exactly the two env flags ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK and ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET the entry names.

resolveNotifyTargetSessionKey.changelog: The `Notify` tool accepts display-name aliases ... Archived sessions are excluded from alias resolution
resolveNotifyTargetSessionKey.why: The Notify target resolver now resolves aliases.

resolveNotifyUnconsumedHours.why: Reads that env key and returns the default when unset or non-numeric.

resolveOutboxByIdIndexPath.changelog: **runtime**: Split outbox replay bootstrap read/write paths so live appends no longer rebuild replay artifacts on every write.
resolveOutboxByIdIndexPath.why: Path of the outbox index/by_id.jsonl that the split replay read/write paths use to avoid rebuilding replay artifacts.

resolveOutboxReplayDir.changelog: **runtime**: Split outbox replay bootstrap read/write paths so live appends no longer rebuild replay artifacts on every write.
resolveOutboxReplayDir.why: Path of the outbox replay/ directory introduced with the replay read/write split.

resolveOutboxReplayFilePath.changelog: **runtime**: Split outbox replay bootstrap read/write paths so live appends no longer rebuild replay artifacts on every write.
resolveOutboxReplayFilePath.why: Per-session replay/<key>.jsonl path used by both split replay paths.

resolvePartitionStatePath.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
resolvePartitionStatePath.why: Path of the per-partition state file used by the scheduler fix.

resolvePendingCompactNotice.changelog: A one-line notice on the session's next reply reports what was compacted and its measured stats, so retuning is based on real numbers rather than guesswork. See the `smart-compaction` skill
resolvePendingCompactNotice.why: Reads last_compact_at and compact_stats (pre/post totals, suggested_min_context_tokens) to decide whether the next reply gets the notice.

resolvePendingModelFork.changelog: `/model <id>` to switch the running session, `/model reset` to restore the daemon default. On Claude sessions the change takes effect on the next turn; on Codex sessions it is applied at the next thread fork.
resolvePendingModelFork.why: Resolves pending_model_fork at Codex drain start and sets forkFrom: the model switch "applied at the next thread fork" on Codex.

resolvePiAgentDir.changelog: `/model` lists the models *this* installation can actually run — resolved from the providers and extensions your pi has, not from a list we hardcoded
resolvePiAgentDir.why: Resolves the pi agent dir from PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR or ~/.pi/agent, where this installation's providers and settings are read.

resolvePiWorkerCommand.changelog: pi joins Claude, Codex and Grok as a fourth agent runtime.
resolvePiWorkerCommand.why: Locates "pi-worker.js" (or worker.ts via tsx) under the package, the process the pi runtime runs.

resolveRemoteListenerConfig.changelog: The remote listener starts only when a host, a port and a token are all present, and every request must carry the token. A misconfigured remote setup — a public address with no token, or a port colliding with the read-only one — refuses to start rather than exposing anything.
resolveRemoteListenerConfig.why: Throws "remote exposure requires ALADUO_DAEMON_TOKEN; run `duoduo daemon token new`", requires an explicit ALADUO_REMOTE_PORT, and refuses a port that does not "differ from the read-only port".

resolveRuntimePaths.changelog: feat(daemon): launchd-based process management for macOS
resolveRuntimePaths.why: Shared path resolver that now includes daemon.stdout.log/daemon.stderr.log (the log files a launchd job writes) and kernelDir (the kernel_dir the entry adds to system.runtime.info).

resolveSessionByKeyOrAlias.changelog: `duoduo session notify <target> -m "<msg>"` — wake another session by key or alias
resolveSessionByKeyOrAlias.why: Resolves a target by exact key or display name, returning ambiguous/not_found

resolveSessionChannelRuntime.changelog: A new runtime value, `void`, for channel plugins whose sessions never run a model. A message to a void session is written to the spine and the outbox and wakes nothing.
resolveSessionChannelRuntime.why: Reads a session's source channel descriptor and kind config to resolve its layered runtime, which isVoidRuntimeSession compares with "void".

resolveSessionMailboxDir.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
resolveSessionMailboxDir.why: Path helper for the new session mailbox/ directory.

resolveSessionMailboxNotesPath.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
resolveSessionMailboxNotesPath.why: Path helper for mailbox/notes.jsonl, the append-only notes log.

resolveSessionMailboxPendingDir.changelog: Cross-cutting runtime I/O optimizations — caching, append-only mailbox, sharded registry, and lazy reads across hot paths.
resolveSessionMailboxPendingDir.why: Path helper for mailbox/pending/, the per-item pending directory.

resolveTurnEffortWithLayer.changelog: Reasoning effort gets the same global → kind → instance layering as the model, so a session's effort no longer depends on the underlying CLI's own configuration file.
resolveTurnEffortWithLayer.why: Effort twin of resolveTurnModelWithLayer: resolves effort from the per-runtime setting with its layer.

resolveTurnModelWithLayer.changelog: Set a default model for Claude, Codex, pi or Grok, globally or per channel kind or per channel instance, with the most specific layer winning.
resolveTurnModelWithLayer.why: Resolves a turn's model from the per-runtime setting (readRuntimeModelSetting) and returns which layer supplied it.

retirePartitionOnce.changelog: The `memory-weaver` subconscious partition is **replaced** by two partitions. Existing partition prompts are never overwritten by an upgrade, so nothing changes until you refresh them

routeContractDecision.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints

runActivationLint.changelog: On top of that sits an activation report: it counts which memories are actually being read during real work, so the pipeline gets told about dead weight and unreachable material instead of accumulating both silently.

runBoardLint.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints

runCadenceTick.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions.

runEntityLint.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints

runInstructionsFingerprintGuard.why: The guard that compares and stamps the fingerprint

runManageJobTool.why: ManageJob handler changed in this release to accept the runtime parameter.

runMemoryCheckTick.why: Async tick that runs the lints (board-lint, entity-lint, ...), posts signals to partition inboxes, and gates forgetMemoryEntry on ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_FORGET.

runNodeLint.changelog: A new cadence-driven memory lint measures the memory tree and routes convergence signals to the subconscious partitions. `ALADUO_EXP_MEMORY_CHECK=1` enables the measure-and-notify lints

scanAndSpawnDueJobs.changelog: Cadence scheduler skips due jobs whose session is being archived

selectInterruptMarkerText.changelog: The model is told when a human ended its turn
selectInterruptMarkerText.why: Chooses the marker text for an abort reason ("user-cancel").

selectProfileIssuesForModel.changelog: A model served through a gateway can now declare its real context window, its own endpoint and credential, and tier aliases, so a session on that model is no longer capped by whatever window the runtime assumed.

setSessionAliasAndReindex.changelog: `duoduo session alias <key> "<name>"` — give a session a human label so it is legible in `list`

shouldKeepRouteDeliverEvent.why: Helper of redactSpineEventForExternal that decides which route.deliver events stay unredacted (those of the void session set).

splitDisallowedToolsForClaude.changelog: `disallowedTools` entries naming built-in tools are now no-ops (MCP tool names still work)
splitDisallowedToolsForClaude.why: Splits disallowedTools into mcp__ entries and built-ins, the distinction the entry draws.

stringifyJsonlRecord.changelog: Log lines containing U+2028 were shredded on read, because the line reader treated it as a line break and JSON does not.
stringifyJsonlRecord.why: Escapes U+2028/U+2029 ("\\u2028", "\\u2029") when serialising a JSONL line, so a line splitter cannot break the record there.

stripBoardHtmlComments.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself
stripBoardHtmlComments.why: Removes <!-- --> blocks before include scanning; only used by parseBoardFileContent

stripBoardIncludeFrontmatter.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself
stripBoardIncludeFrontmatter.why: Removes frontmatter before include scanning; only used by parseBoardFileContent

stripSpineEventToEnvelope.why: Helper of redactSpineEventForExternal that reduces an event to its envelope for external readers.

transcludeBroadcastBoard.changelog: The runtime parses Claude Code's `@<file>` directives itself and injects the rendered import graph into both Claude and Codex sessions through one path.
transcludeBroadcastBoard.why: Single entry point: resolveBoardIncludes then renderTranscludedFiles; also called from collectInstructionsInputs

tryMarkSessionArchiving.changelog: re-checks the archiving marker after the lock is taken.
tryMarkSessionArchiving.why: Sets the in-memory archiving marker that archiveSessionIfQuiescent takes and writers check (entry v0.5.0-rc.2; rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

updateSessionDisplayName.changelog: `duoduo session alias <key> "<name>"` — give a session a human label
updateSessionDisplayName.why: Writes display_name into the session meta file under the session mutex

upsertChannelSpawnDescriptor.changelog: descriptors carry `runtime` (`claude`|`codex`) and spawn provenance; new `channel.describe` / `channel.spawn` RPCs expose the instance lifecycle to channel plugins. Enables per-instance runtime selection without restart.
upsertChannelSpawnDescriptor.why: Literal "channel.spawn creates channel sessions only"; writes descriptor runtime and checks rebind conflicts (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

upsertChannelSpawnDescriptor.changelog: `channel.spawn` never moves a session to another channel. Naming a session that another channel owns is refused before anything is written.
upsertChannelSpawnDescriptor.why: Refuses a session_key owned by another channel before writing the descriptor.

validateConfigValue.changelog: enable and tune per conversation with `duoduo session config <session> set auto_compact_idle_minutes=50 auto_compact_min_context_tokens=100000`.
validateConfigValue.why: Validates a value given to session config set against CHANNEL_CONFIG_KEY_TYPES ("expected a non-negative decimal number").

validateJobScheduleExpression.changelog: `@in` and `@every` now accept composite durations such as `2h30m` and `1d6h4m`. Invalid cron strings, malformed durations, and delays outside the representable time range are rejected when the job is created.
validateJobScheduleExpression.why: Validates once / keepalive / @in / @every / cron (UTC) schedules at creation, rejecting an empty schedule and bad durations.

validateKnownRuntimeValue.changelog: From v0.8.4 the value is refused with a sentence that names it and lists the valid ones.
validateKnownRuntimeValue.why: Its refusal text "sets runtime ... which is not a runtime this duoduo knows. Valid runtimes: ..." is the sentence that names the value and lists the valid ones.

validateRunnableRuntimeValue.changelog: `void` is not accepted as the default runtime, a job runtime or a partition runtime, and should not be set on an ordinary chat channel.
validateRunnableRuntimeValue.why: Refuses with "sets runtime \"void\", which never runs a model, so it cannot run there"; called by resolveDefaultRuntime and parsePartitionDefinition.

verifyClaudeCodeRuntimeAvailable.changelog: Installs that pass `npm install --omit=optional` or set `NPM_CONFIG_OPTIONAL=false` complete, but the daemon refuses to start at boot with an actionable error naming the missing platform package. Reinstall without those flags, or set `CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`
verifyClaudeCodeRuntimeAvailable.why: Reads CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE and throws "…not found in node_modules. This usually means the install ran with --omit=optional" (entry v0.5.0-rc.1; the chain steps 0.4.6→0.5.0 directly, so rc deltas land in 0.5.0)

writeHostClaudeCodeExecutableEnvConfig.changelog: When `duoduo onboard` runs with `CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE` set in the environment … the override is now persisted into the host `.env` so the daemon picks it up on subsequent restarts.
writeHostClaudeCodeExecutableEnvConfig.why: Writes the CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE key line into hostDotEnvPath

writeHostDaemonToken.changelog: If you genuinely need to reach a daemon from another machine, `duoduo daemon token new` generates a bearer token and stores it with owner-only permissions.
writeHostDaemonToken.why: Writes the DAEMON_TOKEN_ENV_KEY line into the host .env (hostDotEnvPath, writeHostDotEnvLines), the store the token command writes to.

writeHostDotEnvLines.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
writeHostDotEnvLines.why: Atomic (.tmp then rename) writer of the host .env used only by the onboarding writers.

writeHostModelEnvConfig.changelog: refactor: simplify host onboarding auth flow
writeHostModelEnvConfig.why: Writes the onboarding model/auth settings into the host .env file.

writePartitionRunState.changelog: **cadence**: Settle subconscious partition scheduling — fix round-robin stalls and idle-tick fanout.
writePartitionRunState.why: Persists per-partition run state (cadence/<partition>.json) for the scheduler.

writeVoidSessionOutboxRecord.changelog: A new runtime value, `void`, for channel plugins whose sessions never run a model. A message to a void session is written to the spine and the outbox and wakes nothing.
writeVoidSessionOutboxRecord.why: Writes a void session's message as an outbox record and emits session.output, the "written to ... the outbox" path.
